categories.name: User & Account Badges
categories.description: Individual account badges displayed directly on Discord user profile cards, covering staff, partners, bug hunters, developer recognitions, and community programs.

categories.name: Nitro & Subscription Badges
categories.description: Subscriber status indicators and milestone tenure gemstone badges commemorating continuous active subscription time on Discord Nitro.

categories.name: Server Boosting Badges
categories.description: Progressive milestone badges displayed on member profiles and server booster lists reflecting continuous server boosting duration.

categories.name: Bot & Application Badges
categories.description: Badges and indicators displayed on Discord bots and apps recognizing modern application command adoption, AutoMod enforcement, and monetization.

categories.name: Server Badges & Tag Icons
categories.description: Indicators displayed on server headers, member lists, and discovery directories signifying partnership, verification, community status, boost levels, ownership, and clan tag badges.

categories.name: Activity & Progression Badges
categories.description: Multi-tier progressive badges (10 tiers per family) celebrating account age milestones, total gameplay hours, gaming variety, and live streaming frequency.

categories.name: Event-Exclusive & Limited-Time Badges
categories.description: Special collectible badges awarded for specific seasonal celebrations, collaborative gaming tournaments, charity fundraisers, and platform milestones.

categories.name: Retired & Legacy Badges
categories.description: Archived badges that can no longer be obtained by new accounts or bots due to program closures, system overhauls, or concluded transition periods.

categories.name: Special Flairs & System Indicators
categories.description: Distinguishable message tags, author labels, and UI indicators that denote automated systems, official staff messages, webhooks, or forum thread creators.

categories.name: Experimental & Rollout Badges
categories.description: Badges documented in active A/B testing, internal staff testing rings, or canary/beta client builds with pending global rollout decisions.

statuses.label: Obtainable
statuses.description: Verified as currently earnable by any eligible user or server fulfilling standard requirements.

statuses.label: Conditionally Obtainable
statuses.description: Obtainable only when active subscription, program invitation, or strict application requirements are maintained.

statuses.label: Limited Time
statuses.description: Obtainable exclusively during an active, documented, time-bounded promotional or event window.

statuses.label: Retired
statuses.description: The earning route has permanently concluded. Existing holders retain the badge, but no new badges are issued.

statuses.label: Historical Only
statuses.description: Associated with past platform eras or short-term trials with no current path to earn.

statuses.label: Staff / Internal Only
statuses.description: Strictly restricted to official Discord personnel, corporate systems, or internal test harnesses.

statuses.label: Experimental
statuses.description: Under active A/B experimentation or staged rollout; not generally available to all accounts.

statuses.label: Announced Upcoming
statuses.description: Officially confirmed by Discord communications for future release but not yet available.

statuses.label: Unconfirmed
statuses.description: Reported through preliminary observations without definitive official or API confirmation.

statuses.label: Unknown
statuses.description: Insufficient verified data available to classify current obtainability.
